CEDEV 452.name: Community Structure, Processes and Capacity
CEDEV 452.description: Social organization, processes, and change in communities; use of sociological principles in the analysis of community problems and development. Real bulletin prerequisite is '6 credits in rural sociology, sociology, or psychology' -- simplified here to a single completed SOC 1/RSOC 11/PSYCH 100 course since the engine's prereq model is course-code based, not credit-count based (same simplification convention used elsewhere in this session, e.g. PHTX's BIOL 110 universal-entrance simplification). SOC 1 is already required earlier in the CED, B.S. (Community and Economic Development option) plan that references this course.
